dedupe_keys.name: odit ensemble des routes de la zone d etude en 1984

description: ODIT - Ensemble des routes de la zone d'étude en 1984 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. This layer represents the roads of the study area in 1984 and their nature. It was obtained by photo-interpretation from aerial photographs of the IGN dating from 1984 and 1985 and by comparison with a topo map 1/50000 of the IGN dating from 1985. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "ODIT - All roads in the study area in 1984" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include France, Besançon, Franche-Comté, Réseaux de transport, 1984. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
